title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > MR > R > R > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > shntool > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar Dark Star performance with high‑quality audio.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, high‑fidelity sound that lets listeners savor one of the band’s most celebrated 1970 Dark Stars, praised by multiple reviewers as “truly stellar” and “beautiful.” The show itself is highlighted for a blazing Dark Star and a fierce, though brief, Mason's Children, making it a must‑hear for fans despite a noted tape cut on the latter.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing 5‑star comments focus on an outstanding Dark Star and excellent audio quality; only minor recording hiccup noted, yielding a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High‑resolution tape copy praised as crystal clear; one reviewer mentions a brief cut in the Mason's Children section but overall the mix is clean and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert centers on a monumental Dark Star with a brief, high‑energy Mason's Children; reviewers note the performance feels cohesive and “on” throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s lead guitar work shines in the lauded Dark Star, described as beautiful and stellar.
